blocks.text: The 100-unit consignment in FG-C has an unreadable original supplier label. Its origin is MC-7421-X or RZ-2650. No exact original-lot identity is available. Keep both possible paths.
SYNTHETIC bounded scope manifest | Dataset 1 | Reviewed fixture assumptions

Universe: NORTH-01 decorative housings, six distinct current finished-stock pools. FG-A/B/D/E/F have reviewed complete ancestry. FG-C has unresolved receiving identity. No additional current finished inventory exists in this synthetic snapshot. All units are on site.

Hold all on-site documented and possible descendants. Unknown ancestry remains uncertain. Shipped stock creates shipment review. Never automatically release existing holds. Approval binds exact evidence, inventory, policy and actions.
TR-A→FG-A; TR-B→FG-B; TR-C→FG-C; TR-D→FG-D; TR-E→FG-E; TR-F→FG-F. The accompanying lineage.csv provides confirmed and possible relations. This manifest does not add inventory.

RX-101/102: MC-7421-X for FG-A/B. RX-103: unresolved FG-C identity. RX-104: BZ-9187 for FG-D. RX-105: PQ-4806 for FG-E. RX-106: NX-6130-Z for FG-F. Quantities exist only at terminal stock; this is not an extra ledger.
SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION DATA — not a real customer or supplier notice.
Our adhesion audit confirmed a cosmetic coating defect in material batch MC-7421-X.
Please contain all on-site stock descended from MC-7421-X pending quality review.
Batch NX-6130-Z appears on the delivery paperwork for traceability only; it is not covered by this defect notice.
This is the complete supplier batch scope for this advisory. Warehouse lots with uncertain ancestry still require conservative review.
SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION DATA — not a real customer or supplier notice.
This message supersedes advisory A in its entirety, following our second inspection.
The complete set of defective coating batches is now BZ-9187 together with MC-7421-X; retain on-site descendants of both.
NX-6130-Z remains outside this supplier notice. A missing warehouse receiving record does not establish that mixed stock is unaffected.
Do not release previously contained stock automatically.
